periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonally oriented approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval morphology with a high major-to-minor axis ratio.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Visible downward tapering where the mass extends significantly below the ocular center.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad and relatively flat U-shaped profile along the posterior boundary.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Consistent high-thickness band covering approximately 35% of the dorsal-torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation distance across the cranial vault.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly rounded convex apex without visible flattening.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced brownish-yellow discoloration of the fur on the posterior-half of the torso and hindquarters compared to the creamy-white anterior region.
